_comment: CANONICAL display labels for refund documents, shared by refund-api's PDF renderers and refund-ui's screens. Neither package imports the other (they are not npm-linked — see CLAUDE.md ### Git), so this file is the contract and BOTH sides assert against it: refund-api/src/requests/labels.test.ts and refund-ui/src/lib/documentLabels.parity.test.ts. Change a label here first, then both implementations. Same mechanism as rates/mileage-vectors.json (ADR-0025).
